exampleEn: To break the ice, he told a funny joke at the start of the meeting.
exampleKo: 어색한 분위기를 깨기 위해 그는 회의 시작에 재미있는 농담을 했다.
gameExamples: She brought a small game to break the ice during the party.
To help everyone relax, the teacher suggested an activity to break the ice.
He decided to share a personal story to break the ice with his new coworkers.
